name: Lance Industries
old_description: Since 1985, Lance Industries has manufactured high-quality commercial meat marinators and vacuum meat tumblers. You can find Lance Industries’ equipment across the globe in meat markets, grocery stores, butcher shops, delis, restaurants, and meat processing facilities.
about:
Lance Industries was founded in 1985 in Hartford, Wisconsin, where it began producing vacuum massage tumblers with design input from Family Farms Meats and the engineering staff at LMI Manufacturing. The company introduced the first American-made meat tumbler, built specifically for the needs of the U.S. meat industry.

The company manufactures four models of commercial vacuum meat tumblers — the LT-5 (50 lb capacity), LT-15 (200 lb), LT-30 (500 lb), and LT-60 (1,000 lb) — featuring variable-speed drives, digital timers, built-in vacuum systems, and wheels on all units for mobility through standard 32-inch doors. Drums are constructed from thicker-gauge steel, and each unit includes a removable lid with a metal-detectable gasket for cleaning and food safety. More than 3,000 tumblers have been installed worldwide.

Lance equipment serves meat markets, grocery stores, butcher shops, delis, restaurants, meat processors, and meat-alternative processors. Customers cited in company materials include Haun's Meat & Sausage, Bardini's Country Smokehouse, Bob's Processing, Hudson Meats, and Quality Cut Meats, which reported a used tumbler still operating after 34 years.

Lance Industries emphasizes durability, reliability, and U.S.-based technical support with a fully stocked repair department. The company is a member of the American Association of Meat Processors (AAMP) and the Wisconsin Association of Meat Processors (WAMP), exhibiting at both national and state conventions to stay close to customer needs.
